notes.title: [FHUOR: Season 2] They're Coming! Sneak Peek at the Cast!
notes.content:
Hello from the Five Hearts Under One Roof dev team!

[h3]Thank you so much for waiting! 🙇
Thanks to all your love and support, Five Hearts Under One Roof? Season 2 is just around the corner.
To show our appreciation, we’ve prepared a special cast preview video![/h3]

Ready to see some familiar faces?

🎬 Mal-sook & Min-jung – “High school hearts, incoming!”
The queens of teen crush moments are back, and just as charming as ever.
👉[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3iC6F0SR4j0] [Watch the video][/url]

🎬 Manager Dong-geuran – “Why is the manager here...?!”
Somewhere between adorable and all grown up—get ready for peak chaos.
👉 [url=https://youtu.be/iyDvoEL13fM?feature=shared][Watch the video][/url]

And this season, we’re welcoming some brand new faces
brought to you by the Milk Film channel! 🎊

🩺 Bbanggyul – “Nurse energy unlocked.”
Calm and caring, with pro-level bedside vibes. What role will she play this time?
👉 [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0xF4O8crnUY][Watch the video][/url]

💎 Yunamong – “Warning: Elegant chaebol energy ahead.”
The type to steal your heart before your wallet.
👉[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SVkAM7htQ-s&t=280s] [Watch the video][/url]

🌟 Yu-jeong Yang – “Wait, who is she?!”
A rising star discovered by Milk Film. She just might be this season’s biggest surprise—
small beginnings, big impact. Remember the name!

Already having a hard time choosing a favorite?
Let these preview videos steal your heart first. 💘
Once again, this house is anything but peaceful...

Thanks so much for your love and excitement! 💕

📲 Stay updated on all things Five Hearts S2 via our official Instagram:
👉  [url=https://www.instagram.com/beautygirls_story?utm_source=ig_web_button_share_sheet&igsh=ZDNlZDc0MzIxNw==]INSTAGRAM[/url]
